correctness.rationale: Universal extension: after fixing an internal matching T the residual k-by-k board has a completed forbidden diagonal 1-factor; the other k-1 factors are disjoint and at most k-2 further forbidden edges cannot meet all of them. For |S|=n-1, every matching has one unused row and column: if they coincide the full trace is impossible; if different, withholding the edge on the missing-column row leaves two forced completions, respectively containing that edge and a forbidden diagonal. Heredity excludes larger supports. Inclusion-exclusion counts off-diagonal matchings, verified independently by DP and brute-force traces (197657 tested supports). For random m=O(sqrt(n)), diagonal conditioning costs O(m/n) and the full-board collision probability tends exp(-c^2). Boundary n=2 holds.

value.rationale: Determines the complete natural shattering polynomial for the full class of derangement-incidence concepts for every n; gives a sharp n-2 dimension, a stronger exact local trace matching-complex identity for arbitrary small supports, a nontrivial near-perfect obstruction, and a sharp random-support birthday window. This links model-theoretic shattering to assignment feasibility and exposes worst-case/random capacity separation. Though the rook-number arithmetic is classical, its equality to VC counts over the precise degree range and the local trace identity have an independent structural motivation.
